items.title: oMLX 0.8.0rc1 lets a Mac offload prefill to an NVIDIA GPU or DGX Spark over a LAN cable
items.summary: The oMLX release candidate adds a CUDA helper, started with one docker run on the NVIDIA box, that takes over prompt prefill while the Mac keeps decoding. On an M3 Ultra with a 64K prompt, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash prefill goes from 1,085 to 2,412 tok/s with a DGX Spark and to 1,914 with two RTX A6000s.

doubt.pushback: Release candidate; the author says use 0.7.3 for stable.

items.title: Open ASR Leaderboard: three open models pass Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe in English within two weeks
items.summary: Hugging Face updates the Open ASR Leaderboard: SOV-Transcribe-1 (27B MoE), fluid-speech-pro (0.6B Parakeet-TDT fine-tune, WER 7.04 to 6.06 at about 8x the throughput of Nemotron) and Musci-ASR-qwen now rank above Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe in English. Scripts and per-sample results are open.

items.title: SWE-sweep leaderboard: DeepSeek 4.1 Flash Max is the first open-weight model above 1% on a bug-finding benchmark
items.summary: SWE-sweep, a joint benchmark from Meta FAIR, Stanford, Harvard and UW, tests agents on finding real bugs. Its leaderboard update shows DeepSeek 4.1 Flash Max as the first open-weight model to clear 1%. Code is MIT licensed.

items.title: TRL v1.18 makes AsyncGRPOTrainer stable: generation and training run at once on separate GPUs
items.summary: TRL 1.18 promotes AsyncGRPOTrainer to stable. A rollout worker streams completions from a plain vllm serve while the trainer pulls from a queue and pushes new weights over NCCL, with tree packing so a shared prompt is forwarded once.

items.title: Matthew Berman open-sources Scarlet, a tool for speeding up AI-assisted video editing review
items.summary: Scarlet is a GitHub repo for reviewing AI edits of video, including dialogue cutting. The author calls it buggy but says it speeds up his editing review.

doubt.pushback: Author describes it as buggy and rough; no measurements given.

items.title: Hyper3D Rigging is live on fal: auto-rig humanoids, quadrupeds, birds and dragons
items.summary: fal hosts Hyper3D Rigging from DeemosTech. It builds skeletons for several creature types, accepts a bone list or text prompt for custom skeletons, adds finger bones on humanoids and ships 280+ stock animations.

items.title: Google DeepMind says it is releasing PARDIG and SatWeave, the datasets behind WeatherNext 3
items.summary: DeepMind announces two observation datasets that underpin its WeatherNext 3 forecasting model, for researchers building climate applications. The lead post carries no download link and the thread was not read.

doubt.pushback: No link, size or license in the lead post.

items.title: NeuroBench: a 2.74 TB MRI and CT benchmark for vision-language models reading brain scans
items.summary: A new Hugging Face dataset of MRI and CT studies that tests how well vision-language models read brain scans. The post gives the size but no link or scores.

doubt.pushback: No dataset link or baseline numbers in the post.
